start: Settings, a member not signed in to a MettleUp account, with own workouts and a gym joined

steps.action: Open Settings, Your data, tap 'Erase or start over'
user_sees: Title 'Erase or start over'
Red link 'Erase all data'
'Deletes everything on this phone and starts over from the welcome screen.'
'Your training is stored on this phone.'
must_not: The erase starting just by opening the page

user_sees: Question 'Erase all data?' naming what goes: 'Every workout, record, routine, body entry, photo and video, your gym link, and your settings. This phone goes back to new.' and the gym the member leaves
Red button 'Erase everything'
must_not: The gym not named when the member is in one

user_sees: 'Erasing...' on the link
The welcome screen
must_not: Some workouts left on the phone with no word
Landing back on the Settings page after the welcome

start: Erase or start over, a member signed in to a MettleUp account

user_sees: Heading 'What do you want to erase?'
'Your workouts are on this phone and saved in your MettleUp account.'
Buttons 'Erase this phone only', 'Erase this phone and delete my MettleUp account', 'Cancel'
must_not: One question that erases both without a choice

steps.action: Tap 'Erase this phone only' and confirm 'Erase everything'
user_sees: The welcome screen
Later sign-in brings the saved copy back ('Your saved copy on MettleUp stays.')
must_not: The MettleUp account copy deleted

start: Erase or start over, a member signed in, online

steps.action: Tap 'Erase all data', then 'Erase this phone and delete my MettleUp account'
user_sees: Question 'Erase this phone and delete your account?' with what goes
Red button 'Erase and delete'
must_not: The account deleted before this last question

user_sees: The welcome screen
must_not: The phone erased while the account delete failed
The account copy still on the server

start: A phone showing the sample member (demo data loaded)

user_sees: Badge 'Demo data loaded'
Red link 'Remove demo data'
'This app is showing a sample member, not your training. Workouts you logged yourself stay.'
must_not: No way to remove the demo

user_sees: 'Removing...'
The Workout tab without the sample member's workouts
must_not: Workouts the member logged themselves removed

start: Erase or start over, signed in, the internet off

steps.action: Tap 'Erase all data', 'Erase this phone and delete my MettleUp account', 'Erase and delete'
user_sees: 'Could not delete your MettleUp account, so nothing was erased. Check your internet and try again.'
Still on the Erase or start over page with every workout
must_not: An empty phone with a full account
A success buzz

start: Erase or start over, a member who changes their mind

steps.action: Tap 'Erase all data', then 'Cancel' on the question (or 'Cancel' under the choice)
user_sees: The page as before, nothing erased
must_not: Any workout or setting erased

steps.action: Press and hold the line 'Your training is stored on this phone.' by mistake, then cancel 'Load demo data?'
user_sees: The page as before
must_not: Demo data loaded without 'Replace with demo' being tapped
The hidden switch described anywhere a member reads

start: Erase or start over, an erase that could not remove one part

steps.action: Tap 'Erase all data' and 'Erase everything' when one part cannot be removed
user_sees: A red line naming what was left behind
Button 'Start over anyway'
must_not: A success buzz while something was left
The welcome screen with the old data still there

user_sees: The welcome screen, then the Workout tab
must_not: Old workouts shown after starting over

steps.action: Remove the demo, come back to Erase or start over
user_sees: No 'Demo data loaded' badge
Only 'Erase all data'
must_not: The badge still shown after the demo is gone
The sample member back after reopening the app

start: Erase or start over, a member in a gym and signed in

user_sees: The gym the member leaves named in the question
'Your backup file in Google Drive stays. Delete it in Google Drive if you want it gone.' when Drive was used
must_not: The member left still listed as an app member at the gym with no word
An account delete promised when only the phone is erased
